headline: Lowell License Commission to review amplified event permits, special one-day alcohol licenses, and a liquor license transfer for Showcase Cinema Lowell at 31 Reiss Ave.
summary: The commission will consider several outdoor amplification permits and special one-day alcohol licenses for events in October and November 2026. It will also continue a public hearing on Lowell alcoholic beverages regulations and discuss a liquor license transfer request for HLE TargetCO LLC at 31 Reiss Ave.
items: Application by Sophia Boucher, Cultural Affairs and Special Events Office, for an amplified outdoor entertainment permit for "Monsterbash and Fall Fest," Saturday, October 24, 2026, 10 AM to 10 PM, on Merrimack Street from Dutton to Central.
Application by Sheila Harrington, Indivisible Lowell, for an amplification permit for "Get Out The Vote Rally," Saturday, October 17, 2026, 11:30 AM to 2:30 PM, at Kerouac Park, 93 Bridge Street.
Application by Ken Michienzi, The Merrimack Textile Company, for an amplification permit for "Lowell PupFest 2026," Saturday, October 31, 2026, 11 AM to 3 PM, at 40 Market Street.
Application by Amanda Etinge for an amplification permit for "Woman's Rally," Saturday, October 24, 2026, 11 AM to 7 PM, at The Hellenic Center, 41 Broadway Street.

Application by Amanda Etinge for special one-day licenses to sell wines and malt beverages at The Hellenic Center, 41 Broadway Street, for "Thanksgiving Celebration" on Saturday, November 14, 2026, and "Clement Celebration of Life" on Saturday, November 21, 2026, both 7 PM to 1 AM.

Application by Kristin McCauley, Merrimack Repertory Theatre, for a special one-day license to sell all alcoholic beverages for a mixer with the Greater Lowell Chamber of Commerce, Thursday, October 22, 2026, 5 to 7 PM, at Lowell Memorial Auditorium, 50 East Merrimack Street.

Applications by Rob Dorris, Aramark at Tsongas Center, for twenty-seven special one-day licenses to sell malt beverages and wines for basketball game concessions at Costello Gym, 261 Riverside Street, on UML North Campus.

Applications by Corey Belanger, Lowell Festival Foundation, for special one-day alcohol licenses for the Fall Buskers' Festival (wines and malt beverages) on Saturday, October 17, 2026, 2 to 6:30 PM, at Derby Park, 70 Middle Street, and the Lowell Bicentennial Celebration (all alcoholic beverages) on Saturday, October 24, 2026, 3 to 10 PM, at 129 Merrimack Street.

Application by Julianna Rodriguez, Libations on Location, for a special one-day license to sell wines and malt beverages at a Lowell Community Charter School film screening, Thursday, November 5, 2026, 5 to 7 PM, at The Luna Theatre in Mill No. 5, 250 Jackson Street.

Applications by Rachel Chandler for two special one-day licenses to sell wines and malt beverages at Hive Public Market, 101 Paige Street, for "Sounds for Socialism" on Saturday, October 17, 2026, 7 to 9 PM, and "Haunting of the Hive" on Saturday, October 24, 2026, 8 to 10 PM.

Application by Ernest Lugo, License Manager of Tescobar Performance Center, for a special event permit to admit 18 to 20 year-old persons at 72 Middlesex Street on Sunday, October 18, 2026, from noon to 8 PM.

Public hearing on an application by HLE TargetCO LLC d/b/a Showcase Cinema Lowell to transfer the all alcoholic beverages restaurant license for 31 Reiss Ave; request to continue hearing to the November 5, 2026 meeting.
Continuation of the public hearing to discuss Lowell alcoholic beverages regulations.
Communications to Commission regarding incidents and events.
